component.name: Wino Mail
component.summary: Mail, calendar, contacts and To Do in one app

description.p: Wino Mail is a native mail client with a calendar, contacts and To Do. It works with Outlook, Gmail, IMAP and Exchange accounts, and with calendars and address books over CalDAV and CardDAV.

ul.li: Unified inbox, threads, rules and categories
Rich composer with signatures and templates
Contacts and tasks next to your mail
